test_docstring_options: test pybind11 docstring options to verify disable and enable function signatures and user defined docstrings
test_disable_function_signatures: test that disable_function_signatures removes function signature from docstrings on pybind11 bound functions
test_custom_docstring: test that a custom docstring is correctly set on a pybind11 bound function
test_overloaded_docstrings: test docstring behavior on overloaded pybind11 functions with docstrings on first, both, or second overload
test_disable_user_defined_docstrings: test that disable_user_defined_docstrings suppresses custom docstrings and that nested enable restores them
